source_caption_text:
That hug maynn 🤒🔥

Lil Yachty surprising Trippie Redd during his Rolling Loud Miami set in 2018 is one of those clips that takes you straight back to that era. Trippie was wrapping up his performance when Yachty suddenly ran onto the stage, catching him completely off guard. The two hugged it out before realizing they had one more song to perform.

The opening of “66” started playing, and the whole mood changed instantly. Yachty and Trippie started bouncing around the stage together while the crowd went crazy, with fans singing along to every word. Seeing the two perform the song together made the surprise even better.

It was a simple moment, but that’s what made it memorable. There was no big announcement or drawn-out setup, Yachty just pulled up while his friend was about to leave the stage and turned it into one last performance. Years later, the footage still feels like a perfect snapshot of that late-2010s SoundCloud era.
